card.name: ZIP+4 digits and fixed label phrases
card.fires_on: Digits or hyphen in the extension of a Bethesda or Rockville ZIP+4 code. Also a few fixed phrases, such as "acute" after "severe and/or" and "the" after "appropriate to".

modes.label: ZIP code extension
modes.description: Digits or the hyphen inside the four-digit extension of a US government address ZIP code.
modes.example: MEDWATCH, Food and Drug Administration (FDA), 5600 Fishers Lane, Rockville, MD 20852-<<9>>782. Telephone: (8

modes.label: Repeated label phrases
modes.description: A single word in a stock label sentence, such as "acute" after "severe and/or".
modes.example: Signs and symptoms associated with more severe and/or<< acute>> cases have included hallucination, syncope

card.plain: It fires on the last digits of US government ZIP codes and on a few stock phrases in drug labels.
